classes.name: TaxRate
classes.description: Class TaxRate provides methods to manage tax rate entries in the OpenCart system, including creating, editing, deleting, and retrieving tax rates and associated customer groups.

methods.name: addTaxRate
methods.description: Add a new tax rate entry to the system.

methods.name: editTaxRate
methods.description: Edit an existing tax rate specified by its ID.

methods.name: deleteTaxRate
methods.description: Remove a tax rate entry from the system.

methods.name: getTaxRate
methods.description: Retrieve details of a specific tax rate by its ID.

methods.name: getTaxRates
methods.description: Retrieve a list of tax rates, optionally filtered by specified criteria.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRates
methods.description: Get the total number of tax rates in the system.

methods.name: getTotalTaxRatesByGeoZoneId
methods.description: Get the total number of tax rates for a specific geo zone.

methods.name: addCustomerGroup
methods.description: Associate a customer group with a tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroups
methods.description: Remove all customer group associations from a tax rate.

methods.name: deleteCustomerGroupsByCustomerGroupId
methods.description: Remove associations for a specific customer group.

methods.name: getCustomerGroups
methods.description: Retrieve customer groups associated with a specific tax rate.
